title: JetBrains/junie
description: An AI coding agent by JetBrains that ships code from your terminal, IDE, or CI/CD pipeline - powered by any LLM you choose

title: marcoantonios1/Forge
description: Terminal-native AI coding agent powered by multiple LLMs. Like Claude Code, but model-agnostic — use local or cloud models via Costguard.

title: CoreForgeLab/AetherDB-OmniS-erch-
description: [AetherDB (OmniS erch)] – An AI‑augmented SQLite database with a FastAPI web interface, pluggable LLM extractors (OpenAI/Ollama), and dual‑layer API key security – deployable on any PC or server and  A large-scale worldbuilding database system for writers and AI agents.

title: tjpoisal/UNIMATRIX
description: Unimatrix is a cloud-native AI memory system that gives any LLM instant, persistent context across devices and sessions. Built around the Model Context Protocol (MCP), it eliminates the need to re-explain context every time you switch tools or devices. Dual-layer mem, hybrid retrieval w/ recency decay, a Librarian agent, and enterprise encryption.

title: mahdi-vakili/divar-chat-scraper
description: Export your Divar chat conversations into structured JSON. Archive conversations, analyze negotiation patterns, or feed them directly into AI agents for summarization and insights. Supports configurable chat limits, deduplication, and outputs clean per-chat + combined files ready for LLM pipelines. Built with Python and Playwright.

title: ljlabs/Route.llm
description: Local LLM proxy and routing engine to bridge Anthropic Messages and OpenAI Chat Completions protocols. Route Claude Code, coding agents, and custom AI clients to OpenRouter, OpenAI, Anthropic, or local offline LLM endpoints.

title: XAIHT/Tlamatini
description: Tlamatini is a self-hosted AI developer assistant for local or cloud LLMs: hybrid RAG over your codebase, a 79-tool multi-turn engine, a 74-agent visual workflow designer, and ACPX, a runtime for external coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor and Gemini CLI.

title: shaumik/PokeArena
description: A Pokémon battle arena where any agent can play — human, deterministic game-tree AI, or LLM — over an open WebSocket protocol (MCP, CLI, or your own client). One leaderboard, ranked by who plays best.

title: okayokay0803/Verso-PoC
description: PoC - agentic AI system that uses a AI language model to autonomously control notebooks(ex.- .ipynb) - observing live  cell state, executing code, and self-correcting broken or incorrect cells without human intervention. The agent demonstrates multi-step tool-use loops, automatic retry with LLM-driven code correction, and context-window management.

title: Mesh-LLM/mesh-llm
description: Distributed AI/LLM for the people. Share compute privately or publicly to power your agents and chat.

title: codeproxy-ai/core
description: @codeproxy/core is a zero-dependency TypeScript library that converts upstream LLM responses in Chat Completions or Anthropic Messages format into the OpenAI Responses API format, so that AI coding agents like Codex and Claude Code can work with any language model.

title: Spitfire-Products/nexus-cortex
description: A headless, multi-provider AI agent harness — embed it as a library, script it from the CLI, or run it as a stateful agent server. One orchestrator drives every major LLM provider.

title: stephonGAO/milu
description: Production-ready multi-user AI agent framework — 9 LLM providers with Chinese models (Qwen, DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM) first-class. Built-in tools, MCP, RAG, sub-agents, skills, scheduler and an agent pool. Run it as a CLI/service, or embed it as a library.

title: aotuai/Structured_Vibe_Coding
description: A CLI tool and methodology for bare-metal LLM control. Generate production code using Claude, Gemini, and GPT without relying on Cursor, Codex, or autonomous agents. Maintain total control over your AI spend—whether your budget is $20 or $200 a month. Built for veteran engineers.

title: CowDogMoo/squad
description: Squad runs unattended AI agents, defined as markdown plus YAML, against any LLM provider in deterministic, cost-capped, resumable tool loops, locally or on Docker, Kubernetes, or EC2

title: mcGeorge66/OpenForexAI
description: OpenForexAI is an autonomous multi-agent Forex trading framework for MetaTrader 5 (and API), combining configurable AI agents, rule-based scripts, risk-aware execution, and strategy optimization. It supports script-only or LLM-assisted trading with rule-driven Decision Prompts.

title: Resolve-public/writing-assistant-chat
description: AI writing assistant for Obsidian with chat, plan, and edit modes. Connects to local or cloud LLM providers. Features vault-wide RAG retrieval, knowledge graph, agentic tool use, note context, and reusable prompt commands.

title: eugenelim/llm-wiki-kit
description: Configurable group operating system and LLM Wiki knowledge management kit for teams and families. Obsidian vault templates, agent skills, and scripts for building structured, AI-maintained markdown knowledge bases. Works with Claude Code, Cowork, or any LLM agent. Includes work and family variants.

title: StephenDenisEdwards/micro-x-agent-loop-python
description: A general personal assistant AI agent loop built with Python and using the Anthropic Claude or OpenAI and LLMs

title: PranjalGoyal06/financial-agent
description: Build an AI-powered Financial Agent using LangChain that can optimize financial decisions and maximize savings or profits. The system should integrate LLM reasoning, external financial APIs/tools, memory, and agent-based workflows to provide accurate, contextual, and actionable financial assistance in real time.
